GAB.note: ARTAC statutes are the body's own rules, not shared digital law taken into national law.

STP.note: Accession to ARTAC is a membership, not a signed or ratified legal text.

facts.fact: Gabon hosted in Libreville the fourth extraordinary session of ARTAC, the Central African telecoms regulators' assembly, which closed on 21 October 2026, according to GabonReview.

Sao Tome and Principe's regulator AGER joined ARTAC, the Central African telecoms regulators' assembly, at its Libreville session closing on 21 October 2026, making eight members, according to GabonReview.
